The NEW Ratel Exotic Assault Rifle has arrived in The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park, and this weapon is definitely something different!

In today’s video, we’re taking a closer look at the Ratel, exploring its unique Exotic talent, Voracious, and understanding how this unusual weapon is intended to function. This isn’t your typical run-and-gun Exotic, and getting the most out of it requires a different approach.

So, how does Voracious work?

* Every 100 weapon hits grants 1 stack.
* You can build up to 4 stacks.
* Each stack provides +20% maximum amplified damage and +15% reload speed.
* At maximum stacks, that’s up to 80% maximum amplified damage and 60% reload speed.
* The damage amplification scales with the amount of armor and health an enemy has lost.
* Stacks begin to decay after 3 seconds without shooting or reloading.

Ratel Exotic Weapon Stats & Mods:

* Optic: +15% Critical Hit Chance.
* Magazine: +20 Rounds.
* Underbarrel: +10% Weapon Handling.
* Third attribute: Randomized, with Damage to Targets Out of Cover being an interesting option.

The Ratel shares its base weapon stats with the high-end Honey Badger, but its Exotic talent and weapon modifications give it a completely different identity.

We’ll also explore how to maintain its stacks, understand its damage potential, and approach combat encounters in a way that makes the most of this weapon.

Echoes of Central Park DLC

The newest DLC takes Agents into the Upper West Side and Central Park in New York, introducing a darker, horror-inspired experience with a new campaign, three companions, six new skill variants, a new gear set, and the Ratel Exotic.

There’s plenty of new content to explore, and this is just one of the new additions worth taking a closer look at.

If you’re still trying to understand this Exotic or wondering how to get the most out of its unusual talent, hopefully this video gives you a better understanding of what makes the Ratel so interesting.

How to get The Ratel, the new Exotic assault rifle from Echoes of Central Park, the easy way. I explain it in Dutch (English subtitles), then we go through the five Guardians: what each one drops on the first kill and what to watch out for, with footage from my own run. At the end, the Jockkie character sings the Ratel song.

The steps
1. Kill the Guardians the first time: you get their first skill set.
2. Then the map resets and you get Containment mode. You have 24 hours to clear all five lairs, so stay in the park until the last kill.
3. Kill them again. Go straight to the red lairs and skip the meter. Guardians get bonus armor in Containment: disable their deployed skills and hit them in the opening.
4. The Ratel is yours. The first full clear guarantees the Exotic, on any difficulty.
5. Want to be stronger on the way? Use the Emerald nodes (Veer Override) and stay on the map to keep the buff.

The Guardians
- Hollow: Leech Hive (80% damage reduction while it is active), throws 3 foam grenades
- Mire: Corrosive Trap (a triggered trap buffs his damage by 500% for 15 seconds)
- Specter: Blackout Seeker (within 15 meters his damage is 500% higher)
- Thorn: Trophy System
- Vulture: Gas Chamber (poisoned targets cannot sprint, 300% damage from 15 meters)
Every Guardian is weak to Disrupt. Each Guardian drops a skill variant on the first kill.
